description: This file defines a service for aggregating total cost of LLM (Large Language Model) usage by agent name, supporting multiple data schemas and implementing both database-level aggregation with MongoDB pipelines and in-process fallback. It includes functions to resolve collection candidates, build aggregation pipelines, perform aggregation, and fallback processing if MongoDB aggregation fails.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines the candidate MongoDB collection names based on environment variables and default options, with deduplication and ordering.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents with various agent and cost schemas, normalizing agent names and summing costs accordingly.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Builds a pipeline for documents where agents and costs are stored in an array of objects, aggregating total costs per agent.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-memory aggregation of agent costs from a provided array of documents, used as a fallback when database aggregation fails.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported function that attempts to perform collection-level aggregation using pipelines, falling back to in-process aggregation if MongoDB aggregation fails.
